pieces.Text: Imitating the forms of your god, you strike deep and inflict a bloody wound.

If you hit an opponent with both your primary weapon and your off-hand weapon as part of the same attack action, and both of those weapons are sawtooth sabres, you deal 1 point ofbleed damage in addition to the normal damage dealt by these attacks.

Situational.text: Prerequisites: Dex 15, Exotic Weapon Proficiency (sawtooth sabre), Two-Weapon Fighting, worshiper of Achaekek.
